description: ⚠️ SENDS TO REAL RECIPIENTS. Trigger an API-triggered broadcast, delivering to the resolved recipient set. App API: POST /v1/send/broadcast (posts to /v1/campaigns/{broadcast_id}/triggers).

data.description: Liquid variables available to the broadcast templates.

email_ignore_missing.description: Skip recipients missing an email instead of erroring.

id_ignore_missing.description: Skip recipients missing an id instead of erroring.

recipients.description: Recipient filter object (overrides the broadcast's configured audience).
